invariants.rationale: Returned HoodieWriteMetadata object should not be null as it is constructed and returned from a freshly executed action.
List of preppedRecords given as parameter is required for insert and assumed to be non-null.
instantTime should represent a specific commit instant and should not be null when performing an insert operation.
HoodieEngineContext represents the execution context which is necessary and should not be null during method execution and delegation.
